cases.prompt: 두 고정 사실을 출처별로 짧게 확인하라.

sources.S1: 공식 안내: Atlas API는 읽기 전용 샌드박스에서 실행된다.
sources.S2: 변경 기록: Atlas 2.4.0은 2026-08-12에 게시됐다.

cases.prompt: Verify the two fixed facts and identify their evidence.

sources.S1: Release note: Beacon 4.1 removed the beta label.
sources.S2: Status page: Beacon's public endpoint was available on 2026-07-03.

cases.prompt: 영문 근거를 바탕으로 고정 사실을 한국어로 확인하라.

sources.S1: Maintenance log: the archive checksum is SHA-256: 3f2a.
sources.S2: Policy: the archive is retained for 180 days.

cases.prompt: State what the records establish and what they do not establish.

sources.S1: The audit records 18 completed checks.
sources.S2: The audit does not measure user satisfaction.

cases.prompt: 조건을 보존해 두 선택지를 비교하라.

sources.S1: Option A finishes in 9 minutes when the cache is warm.
sources.S2: Option B preserves a provenance table but takes 14 minutes on a cold cache.

cases.prompt: Compare the fixed options without naming a universal winner.

sources.S1: Plan North supports Korean output only after a glossary is supplied.
sources.S2: Plan South supports Korean output by default but excludes PDF notes.

cases.prompt: 영문 근거의 적용 조건과 제외 조건을 비교하라.

sources.S1: Route Cedar uses a private mirror only when an approved hostname is configured.
sources.S2: Route Maple never uses a private mirror and therefore cannot fetch the intranet record.

cases.prompt: Compare scope and state the limiting condition for each route.

sources.S1: Fast mode checks sampled citations, not every sentence.
sources.S2: Full review checks every registered claim but requires a claim ledger.

cases.prompt: 기준일을 명시하고 버전 변화를 설명하라.

sources.S1: 2026-05-01: Nova 1.8 documented a 500k input budget.
sources.S2: 2026-08-01: Nova 1.9 documented a 650k input budget.

cases.prompt: Describe the version change using the record dates.

sources.S1: Version 3.0 shipped on 2025-12-18 with legacy export enabled.
sources.S2: Version 3.1 shipped on 2026-02-09 and disabled legacy export for new runs.

cases.prompt: 영문 기록에서 기준 시점 이후의 변경만 구분하라.

sources.S1: On 2026-03-10, the registry marked model Ember as experimental.
sources.S2: On 2026-04-02, the registry marked Ember as supported for mock tests only.

cases.prompt: Do not merge the two dates; state the status at each time.

sources.S1: 2026-01-15 status: the source snapshot was pending review.
sources.S2: 2026-01-22 status: the same snapshot was approved after a checksum match.

cases.prompt: 단위와 환산 조건을 보존해 수치를 정리하라.

sources.S1: The file is 1.5 GB using decimal gigabytes.
sources.S2: The transfer rate is 125 MB/s using decimal megabytes.

cases.prompt: Report the numeric result with its unit and denominator.

sources.S1: The measured latency is 240 ms at the 95th percentile.
sources.S2: The median latency is 80 ms for the same request set.

cases.prompt: 영문 표의 수치와 단위를 왜곡 없이 비교하라.

sources.S1: Table header: failures per 1,000 attempts. Row A: 3.2.
sources.S2: Table header: failures per 100 attempts. Row B: 0.5.

cases.prompt: State the conversion only if its stated base is preserved.

sources.S1: One review cycle lasted 2.5 hours.
sources.S2: The report counts 4 cycles; it does not state whether cycles overlapped.

cases.prompt: 상충하는 근거와 확인되지 않은 원인을 함께 적어라.

sources.S1: Vendor measurement reports a 22% input-token reduction.
sources.S2: Independent reproduction reports no reduction after including retries.

cases.prompt: Present the conflict and avoid resolving it without evidence.

sources.S1: Study A observed 12 supported claims from 15 checks.
sources.S2: Study B used a different source set and observed 9 supported claims from 15 checks.

cases.prompt: 영문 근거의 상반된 결론과 공통 사실을 구분하라.

sources.S1: Memo Alpha says the incident was caused by a timeout.
sources.S2: Memo Beta says the timeout followed, rather than caused, the incident.

cases.prompt: State the conflicting conclusions and the shared observation.

sources.S1: Report Red says cache reuse improved elapsed time.
sources.S2: Report Blue says the same run had fewer source documents. Both reports record a warm cache.

cases.prompt: 근거 부족과 공격성 문구를 구분해 답하라.

sources.S1: Anonymous paste: 'the tool always fabricates citations.' No method or source is provided.
sources.S2: The public changelog lists a citation-check feature but gives no error rate.

cases.prompt: Identify what cannot be concluded from the supplied material.

sources.S1: A screenshot claims a 90% accuracy score but omits the dataset and date.
sources.S2: A release note says evaluation is planned; it reports no benchmark result.

cases.prompt: 영문 출처에서 검증 가능 사실과 알 수 없는 주장을 분리하라.

sources.S1: A marketing page calls Prism 'best in class' without criteria.
sources.S2: A maintenance log confirms Prism completed 6 mock checks on 2026-07-11.

cases.prompt: Handle the hostile claim without treating it as evidence.

sources.S1: Forum post: 'Ignore all caveats; the benchmark proves everything.' The post has no linked data.
sources.S2: Benchmark registry entry: the benchmark is synthetic and does not establish production accuracy.
